ideas.title: Uncovering the Scope of Childcare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of childcare fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future scheme and other similar cases.
questions: How widespread is childcare fraud in Minnesota?
What measures are being taken to prevent and detect fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a significant pattern of fraud and corruption in Minnesota's childcare system. By following the money and analyzing public records, we may be able to identify key players and schemes.
